criteria: 须声明个人数据处理遵循合法、公平、透明原则
law_text: Personal data shall be processed lawfully, fairly and in a transparent manner in relation to the data subject ('lawfulness, fairness and transparency').

criteria: 须说明收集目的为特定、明确、合法，不为不兼容目的处理
law_text: Personal data shall be collected for specified, explicit and legitimate purposes and not further processed in a manner that is incompatible with those purposes.

criteria: 须说明仅收集与处理目的相关、必要的数据
law_text: Personal data shall be adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary in relation to the purposes for which they are processed ('data minimisation').

criteria: 须说明以可识别形式保存不超过必要期限
law_text: Personal data shall be kept in a form which permits identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary.

criteria: 须说明处理基于至少一项合法性基础（同意、合同、法定义务、重大利益、公务、合法利益）
law_text: Processing shall be lawful only if and to the extent that at least one of the following applies: (a) consent; (b) performance of a contract; (c) legal obligation; (f) legitimate interests.

criteria: 若以同意为合法性基础，须说明同意系自由给予、具体、知情、明确，且可撤回
law_text: Where processing is based on consent, the controller shall be able to demonstrate that the data subject has given consent. The request for consent shall be presented in a manner which is clearly distinguishable.

checkpoint: 特殊类别（敏感）数据的处理条件
criteria: 若处理特殊类别数据（健康、生物识别、种族、宗教等），须说明具备第9(2)条法定例外之一
law_text: Processing of personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs, health, biometric or genetic data shall be prohibited except under specific conditions in Article 9(2).

checkpoint: 以清晰易懂语言提供信息
criteria: 须说明信息以清楚、平实语言提供给数据主体
law_text: The controller shall take appropriate measures to provide any information … in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form, using clear and plain language.

checkpoint: 控制者身份与联系方式
criteria: 须提供控制者（及共同控制者）的身份与联系方式
law_text: The controller shall provide the data subject with the identity and contact details of the controller and, where applicable, of the controller's representative.

criteria: 若已任命 DPO，须提供其联系方式
law_text: Where applicable, the contact details of the data protection officer shall be provided.

checkpoint: 处理目的与合法性基础
criteria: 须说明处理目的及所依据的合法性基础
law_text: The purposes of the processing and the legal basis for the processing.

criteria: 若以合法利益为合法性基础，须说明该合法利益
law_text: Where the processing is based on point (f) of Article 6(1), the legitimate interests pursued by the controller or by a third party.

criteria: 须说明个人数据可能向其披露的接收方或接收方类别
law_text: The recipients or categories of recipients of the personal data.

checkpoint: 跨境传输意图及保障措施
criteria: 若拟向第三国/国际组织传输，须说明传输目的地及保障措施
law_text: Where applicable, the fact that the controller intends to transfer personal data to a third country or international organisation.

criteria: 须说明个人数据的保存期限或确定标准
law_text: The period for which the personal data will be stored, or if that is not possible, the criteria used to determine that period.

criteria: 须告知数据主体享有的各项权利（访问、更正、删除、限制、可携带、反对等）
law_text: The existence of the right to request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and to object.

criteria: 须告知数据主体有权随时撤回同意
law_text: The right to withdraw consent at any time, where processing is based on consent.

criteria: 须告知向监管机构投诉的权利
law_text: The right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

checkpoint: 提供数据的法定义务/合同义务
criteria: 须说明提供个人数据是否基于法定/合同义务或为签约所必需
law_text: Whether the provision of personal data is a statutory or contractual requirement.

checkpoint: 自动化决策（含画像）告知
criteria: 若进行自动化决策/画像，须说明相关逻辑、重要性及后果
law_text: The existence of automated decision-making, including profiling, and meaningful information about the logic involved.

checkpoint: 非直接收集时的额外告知
criteria: 若数据非从数据主体处直接获取，须告知数据来源及是否来自公开来源
required_patterns: not obtained from the data subject
law_text: Where personal data have not been obtained from the data subject, the controller shall provide the data subject with the categories of personal data concerned and the source.

criteria: 须保障数据主体的访问权（确认处理、获取副本）
law_text: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller confirmation as to whether personal data are being processed and a copy.

criteria: 须保障数据主体更正不准确数据的权利
law_text: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller without undue delay the rectification of inaccurate personal data.

criteria: 须保障数据主体在法定情形下请求删除的权利
law_text: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller the erasure of personal data without undue delay.

criteria: 须保障数据主体在特定情形下限制处理的权利
law_text: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller restriction of processing where one of the conditions in Article 18(1) applies.

criteria: 须保障数据主体以结构化、常用、机器可读格式获取并传输数据的权利
law_text: The data subject shall have the right to receive the personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and to transmit it.

criteria: 须保障数据主体基于其特定情形反对处理（含直接营销）的权利
law_text: The data subject shall have the right to object, on grounds relating to his or her particular situation, to processing of personal data.

checkpoint: 不受纯自动化决策约束的权利
criteria: 须说明数据主体有权不受仅基于自动化决策（含画像）且产生法律或类似重大影响的决策约束
law_text: The data subject shall have the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, which produces legal or similarly significant effects.

checkpoint: 处理安全（技术与管理措施）
criteria: 须说明已采取适当技术与管理措施保障安全（含加密、假名化）
law_text: The controller and processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.

checkpoint: 数据泄露通知监管机构
criteria: 须说明发生个人数据泄露时在 72 小时内通知监管机构的义务
law_text: In the case of a personal data breach, the controller shall without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, notify the breach to the supervisory authority.

checkpoint: 数据泄露通知数据主体
criteria: 须说明高风险泄露时通知数据主体的义务
law_text: When the personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk, the controller shall communicate the breach to the data subject without undue delay.

criteria: 对高风险处理活动须开展 DPIA
law_text: Where a type of processing is likely to result in a high risk, the controller shall carry out an assessment of the impact of the envisaged processing operations on the protection of personal data.

checkpoint: 任命数据保护官（DPO，适用时）
criteria: 在法定情形下须任命 DPO
law_text: The controller and the processor shall designate a data protection officer in cases specified in Article 37.

criteria: 向第三国/国际组织传输须确保 GDPR 保护水平不被减损
law_text: Any transfer of personal data to a third country shall take place only if, subject to other provisions, the conditions laid down in this Chapter are complied with.

checkpoint: 基于充分性认定的传输
criteria: 若依据充分性决定传输，须说明该依据
law_text: A transfer of personal data to a third country may take place where the Commission has decided that the third country ensures an adequate level of protection.

criteria: 若无充分性决定，须说明所采用的适当保障措施（标准合同条款、约束性企业规则等）
law_text: In the absence of a decision pursuant to Article 45(3), a controller may transfer personal data where appropriate safeguards are provided.

checkpoint: 特定情形下的减损条款
criteria: 若依据第49条减损条款（如明示同意、合同必要）传输，须说明依据
law_text: In the absence of an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards, a transfer may take place only on specified derogations in Article 49(1).

criteria: 若向儿童提供信息社会服务，须说明儿童同意年龄规则
law_text: Where the child is below the age of consent (not below 13 years), processing shall be lawful only if consent is given or authorised by the holder of parental responsibility.

checkpoint: 向监管机构投诉的权利
criteria: 须告知数据主体向成员国监管机构投诉的权利
law_text: Without prejudice to any other administrative or judicial remedy, every data subject shall have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

criteria: 可提示违规可能面临的行政罚款（最高 2000 万欧元或全球营业额 4%）
law_text: Infringements may be subject to administrative fines up to 20,000,000 EUR, or in the case of an undertaking, up to 4% of total worldwide annual turnover.
